Urea + Gypsum (Calcium Sulfate)��� Leads to nitrogen loss.
Urea + Lime or Dolomite: ���Causes nitrogen volatilization (nitrogen escapes into the air).
Urea + Potash (MOP/KCl)��� Under high humidity, urea decomposes quickly and loses effectiveness.
TSP + Lime: Reduces the effectiveness of phosphorus in TSP.
Gypsum + Lime: Disturbs calcium balance, making it ineffective in the soil.
Organic Manure (Cow dung/Compost) + Urea applied in the same pit: Generates heat, releases ammonia gas ��� causes nitrogen loss.
